title: LeetCode 1000
description: The first 1000 LeetCode problems (950 algorithm problems; database/shell problems excluded) for offline practice. Organized by LeetCode problem-number ranges (the numbers shown are LeetCode IDs). If you notice anything wrong (e.g. missing test cases or incorrect grading), please open an issue in the [repo](https://github.com/cojudge/cojudge).
